model: 4D spherical Einstein massless real scalar field, G=c=1, polar areal coordinates

equations.mass_flux: d_t m=4 pi r^2 alpha/a^3 Phi Pi

numerics.initial_data: regular reflected ingoing flat-space Gaussian shell used as scalar initial data; solve GR constraints
numerics.integrator: RK4, shell-volume flux divergence, centered flux, weak fourth-difference dissipation

gates.flat_wave: relative L2 errors decrease with each resolution; finest error <0.05
gates.dispersal: t=16, inner mass at r=3 <5% initial outer mass and final max compactness <0.2
gates.strong: stop when compactness >=0.85 after initial compactness <0.65; proxy only
gates.resolution: same class at 768 and 1536; label agreement is not event horizon detection
gates.neural: only if controls and sufficient converged labels; train on first family, evaluate second; compare logistic-like threshold baseline; no promotion

claim_ceiling: Finite-resolution dynamical scalar field evolution and near-trapping proxy; no trapped surface crossing, no event horizon, no measured Choptuik exponent, no DSS discovery. Old R1/R2 data kept for reference; weights not inherited.
